name: Collins
description: Each morning brings one question from Hercules Collins's 1680 Orthodox Catechism, waits for your attempt, then supplies the historical answer for comparison. Suited to households or individuals already committed to that particular Reformed text; it teaches by repetition rather than explanation, and assumes you want the drill.
